recovery.note: Reached publish and failed on @zeus-js/compiler-native-linux-x64-gnu with TLOG_CREATE_ENTRY_ERROR (409): npm's sigstore client found an equivalent Rekor entry already present for that exact tarball, and @baicie/release retries only on E409/EPUBLISHCONFLICT, not on that code. compiler-native-darwin-arm64, eslint-plugin and playground-engine published before the failure; every package after it, including @zeus-js/i18n, did not run. rc.4 re-cuts the whole line so every tarball is new and no Rekor entry can collide.

note: eslint-plugin and playground-engine have latest bound to 0.2.0-rc.3 from that release; naming them here records that the prerelease latest predates this cut and is the first-publication state, not a regression this release introduces.
